name: Ira Cline Farm
description: In 444 Lee Cline Road, NC, Ira Cline Farm raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
